public.title: Spiral Matrix
public.description: Return matrix entries in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left corner moving right. A rectangular matrix has 0 to 30 rows and 0 to 30 columns, with integer entries from -1000 to 1000. Empty matrices return [].
hints: Maintain the four boundaries of the remaining rectangle.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Consume a top row, right column, bottom row and left column, checking boundaries before the last two. Every cell is visited once.
